The agenda you write in a meeting draft now stays in front of you during the meeting, and whatever you didn't get to carries into the report.

**Agenda, tracked live** (#698)

- A meeting started from a draft shows its agenda between the meeting window's title bar and its tabs, so you see it on every tab: how many items are covered, a progress bar, and the next item to bring up.
- Click it to open the checklist. Parley ticks items as they're covered in the conversation, and you can tick or untick any item yourself. An item Parley ticked shows when it came up, for example AI · 3:12; click that to jump to the line in the transcript.
- If you untick something Parley ticked, it stays unticked.
- The small meeting window shows the count next to the timer.
- If the draft has an end time, Parley reminds you once, five minutes before it, about items not yet covered.
- The agenda is saved with the recording. The report's 後續行動 tab lists the items that weren't covered, with a button to carry them into a new meeting draft.

**Softer voice-typing sounds** (#692)

- Voice typing now starts and stops with a short, soft sound: higher to start, lower to stop. It replaces the macOS system sounds, and Windows plays the same two sounds.
